body.name: Overlap-aligned tangent-packing handle
body.construction: Start from the least singular directions of the cohort overlap Grams, lift them into \(\mathcal T_n(L_n)\), assign a Varshamov--Gilbert sign code across orthogonal cohort charts, and use the fixed-rank exponential-map retraction while bounding the observed Gaussian Kullback--Leibler divergence of the resulting tuple-indexed laws \(\mathbb Q_{\vartheta,n}\).
